Frequently asked questions

What is a co-ord set?

A co-ord (coordinated) set is a matching two-piece outfit, usually a top or shirt with pants, made in the same fabric or print.

Is a rayon co-ord set good for summer?

Rayon is light and breathable, so a rayon co-ord set like the NAINVISH set on this page is comfortable in warm weather.
